products.name: Grilled Chicken with Vegetables
products.description: Tender grilled chicken breast seasoned with garlic, paprika, black pepper, and fresh herbs, served alongside a colorful selection of roasted vegetables including zucchini, bell peppers, carrots, and broccoli. The chicken remains juicy while the vegetables add a fresh and slightly smoky flavor, making this a balanced and satisfying meal.

products.name: Beef Burger with Fries
products.description: A thick and juicy beef burger served in a toasted bun with melted cheese, lettuce, tomato, onions, and a creamy homemade sauce. It comes with a generous portion of crispy golden fries seasoned with salt and herbs, making it a classic comfort meal with rich and savory flavors.

products.name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
products.description: Fresh pasta covered in a rich and creamy mushroom sauce made with garlic, parmesan cheese, herbs, and a touch of cream. The mushrooms are cooked until golden and tender, giving the dish a deep savory flavor while the parmesan adds richness and a smooth texture.

products.name: Spicy Beef Tacos
products.description: Soft tortillas filled with seasoned beef, fresh tomato, lettuce, onions, cheese, and a spicy homemade sauce. The beef is cooked with chili, cumin, paprika, and garlic, giving every taco a warm and slightly spicy taste that is balanced by the fresh vegetables and creamy cheese.

products.name: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowl
products.description: A soft and flaky salmon fillet glazed with a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce, served over steamed rice with fresh vegetables and sesame seeds. The combination of tender salmon, warm rice, crunchy vegetables, and slightly sweet sauce creates a flavorful and filling meal.

products.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
products.description: A fresh salad made with crispy romaine lettuce, grilled chicken breast, parmesan cheese, crunchy croutons, and a creamy Caesar dressing. The chicken adds a warm and savory flavor while the lettuce and croutons provide freshness and texture, making this a light but satisfying meal.

products.name: BBQ Chicken Pizza
products.description: A freshly baked pizza topped with barbecue chicken, mozzarella cheese, red onions, tomato sauce, and a smoky barbecue drizzle. The crust is thin and crispy around the edges while remaining soft inside, creating a rich combination of smoky, sweet, and savory flavors.

products.name: Chicken Curry with Rice
products.description: Tender pieces of chicken slowly cooked in a creamy curry sauce made with coconut milk, garlic, ginger, tomatoes, and aromatic spices. The curry is served with warm steamed rice that absorbs the flavorful sauce, creating a comforting dish with a rich and slightly spicy taste.

products.name: Pork Ribs with Potatoes
products.description: Slow-cooked pork ribs covered in a smoky barbecue glaze and served with crispy roasted potatoes. The ribs are cooked until extremely tender and flavorful, while the potatoes are seasoned with garlic, rosemary, and black pepper for a hearty and satisfying combination.

products.name: Shrimp Garlic Pasta
products.description: Juicy shrimp sautéed with garlic, butter, herbs, and a small amount of chili, served over freshly cooked pasta. The sauce combines the flavors of garlic, lemon, parmesan, and butter, creating a rich but fresh seafood pasta with a light spicy finish.
